name: Athenar
sum: Athenar is a dicraeosaurid sauropod from the Late Jurassic of Utah, based on a skull once assigned to Diplodocus.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A skull with braincase, first assigned to Diplodocus and described by Berman and McIntosh in 1978.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Whitlock et al. 2025
